method: Full reads of three pinned files, Git blob/SHA256 verification. Original validate_order and path_index AST-extracted and executed on synthetic rows across all 570 generated legal criterion combinations. Upstream scanner not executed.
findings: Sorting test generates 570 legal length-one through length-three criteria over five keys with ascending/descending forms. It asserts six output rows and pairwise order, but does not assert six distinct authored paths or original flags in this test.

Original order validator accepts six identical path/mtime records across all 570 combinations. Reversed-name negative control raises AssertionError, confirming ordering checks execute. This isolates missing membership/uniqueness validation; it is not a scanner defect reproduction.

Regex tests cover eight-pattern limit, invalid/empty expressions, escaped brackets and tie-breaking through later criteria. Multiple-match regression additionally asserts exact ordered path list on three runs; this is stronger membership evidence than generic sorting helper.

Outlier/hardlink sorting tests assert leading selected path under ranking combinations, not whole result partition. rankby tests assert complete expected basename or relative-path sequences for small fixtures and directory/file ordering.

Tagged/untagged policy test covers seven flag combinations, output sizes and aggregate duplicate counts. It uses backup/ substring checks for protected paths rather than asserting every group/member/original mapping. These explicit policies can intentionally omit content-equal files.
limits: No new production change or upstream suite execution.
125/289 tracked blobs reviewed; global complete-repository count remains unchanged.
